<!-- =============================================================================== -->
## Python errors
<!-- =============================================================================== -->

Syntax error: when Python cannot recognize your code as Python code, it is not
run at all.

Runtime error: a fault Python does not discover until your code runs.

[Remember that even when your code runs fine, that is no guarantee it does what
you think it does :-)]{.alert}


<!-- =============================================================================== -->
## Three errors
<!-- =============================================================================== -->

:::  {.code}
```{.python code-line-numbers="|1|2|3"}
print( , "Hello")
prit("Hello")
print "Hello"
```
:::

<!-- =============================================================================== -->
## Math operators
<!-- =============================================================================== -->

::::: {layout="[0.45,-0.05,0.5]"}

::: column
|      |               |
|------|---------------|
| `+`  | plus          |
| `-`  | minus         |
| `*`  | times         |
| `/`  | divide        |
:::

::: column
|      |                     |
|------|---------------------|
| `**` | exponent            |
| `%`  | modulo (remainder)  |
| `//` | integer division    |
:::

:::::


<!-- =============================================================================== -->
## Operator precedence
<!-- =============================================================================== -->

| Level   | Category       | Operators     |
|---------|----------------|---------------|
| Highest | exponent       | `**`          |
|         | multiplication | `*, /, //, %` |
| Lowest  | addition       | `+, -`        |
